title: League of Legends Patch 26.17 Notes
overview: Patch 26.17 gives top lane a breather by nerfing Nasus and Vayne, hands melee AD carries (Irelia, Yasuo, Yone, Qiyana) real late-game scaling instead of snowball-or-lose, and trims the jungle/mid overperformers Xerath, Nocturne, and Graves. Sundered Sky takes a second nerf pass while Stormrazor gets a small buff, plus big League Classic, ARAM Mayhem, and Arena update rounds.
summary: Yasuo and Yone's crit damage penalty is halved (-10% ⇒ -5%), so early crit builds and late-game scaling both get noticeably stronger.
Vayne gets hit hard for top lane: Q Tumble now costs up to 46 mana at rank 1 and W Silver Bolts true damage drops to 4% at rank 1, while Nasus loses passive lifesteal (24% ⇒ 20% max).
Xerath, Nocturne, Graves, and Thresh all take nerfs after overperforming, with Graves losing big bonus AD ratios on Q.
Sundered Sky is nerfed again (400 HP, 40 AD) while Stormrazor climbs to 25% attack speed.
changelogHighlights: ARAM: Mayhem adds new fighter Augments Ultra Hydra and Upgrade Death's Dance; Double Tap moves to Prismatic and Upgrade Infinity Edge loses its crit chance.
League Classic adds Champion and Role swapping in Champion Select plus the first in-client Council vote.

champions.summary: Q mana cost down and W cooldown improved at higher ranks.
champions.details: Breath of Light costs 5 less mana per second at every rank and Astral Flight's cooldown drops to 14s at rank 5 (from 16s), making W the clear second max and letting you reposition far more freely.
champions.name: Aurelion Sol

champions.summary: E - Vorpal Spikes gains 10 base damage per rank.
champions.details: Vorpal Spikes now deals 30-110 base damage per hit instead of 20-100, restoring some of the early trading power Cho'Gath lost to Hail of Blades and Hextech Rocketbelt nerfs.
champions.name: Cho'Gath

champions.summary: Q - End of the Line loses 10% bonus AD on both hits.
champions.details: Initial damage drops to 55% bonus AD and return damage to 45-105% bonus AD, so high-AD Graves builds snowball games less violently out of the jungle.
champions.name: Graves

champions.summary: Q AD ratio up to 80%, plus R and W AP ratio buffs.
champions.details: Bladesurge now scales at 80% AD (from 70%) so Irelia actually threatens as a fed carry, and R Vanguard's Edge standardizes to 100% AP with W damage reduction at 8% per 100 AP for ARAM/Arena builds.
champions.name: Irelia

champions.summary: Attack speed ratio normalized, W and Mimic W AP ratios up to 90%.
champions.details: Her attack speed ratio jumps from 0.4 to 0.625 (with slower growth) while Distortion and Mimic: Distortion gain 10% AP scaling, pushing her back toward pure AP assassination builds.
champions.name: LeBlanc

champions.details: Soul Eater lifesteal drops by 2-4% per rank, meaning Nasus top can no longer sustain through lane nearly as freely off minions while stacking Q.
champions.name: Nasus

champions.details: Armor falls 38 ⇒ 36 and health 655 ⇒ 640, adding real risk to Nocturne's early jungle clear and skirmishes before he unlocks his ult.
champions.name: Nocturne

champions.summary: Q damage up but monster damage modifier down.
champions.details: Elemental Wrath gains 10 base damage and 5% bonus AD scaling while its monster modifier drops to 160%, deliberately steering her power back to mid lane and away from jungle.
champions.name: Qiyana

champions.summary: E - Flay damage reduced by 10 base and 10% AP.
champions.details: Flay now deals 65-245 (+60% AP), a quiet trim to a support who's been climbing in both winrate and playrate.
champions.name: Thresh

champions.summary: W - Frozen Domain attack speed up to 110% at max rank.
champions.details: Frozen Domain now grants 30/50/70/90/110% attack speed instead of maxing at 90%, giving Trundle far more personal damage inside his own zone.
champions.name: Trundle

champions.summary: Q now costs escalating mana and W true damage gutted at early ranks.
champions.details: Tumble costs 46 mana at rank 1 (scaling down to 30) and Silver Bolts' true damage starts at 4% max HP with lower minimum damage, plus flatter health and attack speed growth — a targeted hit on Vayne top that still stings in lane anywhere.
champions.name: Vayne

champions.summary: Base health and Q damage reduced.
champions.details: Health drops 596 ⇒ 575 and Arcanopulse loses 5 base damage per rank, a light tap on a mid laner with a very high ban rate.
champions.name: Xerath

champions.summary: Crit damage penalty halved from -10% to -5%.
champions.details: Way of the Wanderer now only reduces crit damage by 5%, which rewards early Infinity Edge-style crit builds over Blade of the Ruined King and gives Yasuo a genuine scaling curve.
champions.name: Yasuo

champions.summary: Crit damage penalty halved from -10% to -5%.
champions.details: Way of the Hunter's crit penalty drops to 5%, giving Yone the same crit-build payoff as Yasuo so he doesn't have to snowball to matter.
champions.name: Yone

items.details: Stormrazor now gives 25% attack speed instead of 20%, an attempt to make it a real option again for crit and on-hit marksmen.
items.name: Stormrazor

items.details: Sundered Sky drops to 400 health and 40 attack damage after last patch's nerf landed under target, so bruisers relying on it lose both durability and damage.
items.name: Sundered Sky

systems.summary: Two new fighter Augments and ADC Augment nerfs.
systems.details: ARAM: Mayhem adds Ultra Hydra (quest for Ravenous, Profane, and Titanic Hydra) and Upgrade Death's Dance, while Critical Missile caps at 3 missiles, Double Tap becomes Prismatic, and Upgrade Infinity Edge loses its crit chance.

systems.summary: Outlier tuning plus many Arena Mods removed.
systems.details: Ambessa and Zaahen lose damage, Zilean and Vel'Koz ults get longer cooldowns, while Garen, K'Sante, Kled, Tahm Kench, LeBlanc, Senna, and Teemo get buffs; Lord Dominik's Regards jumps to 45 AD, enchanter items are normalized to 10% heal/shield power, and Spectral Cutlass no longer double-dips Lethality.

systems.summary: Arena balance patches move to odd-numbered patches only.
systems.details: Arena is shifting back to an alternating schedule so builds and discoveries aren't balanced away as quickly.

systems.summary: Doubled IP and XP gains, cheaper runes, and two free Rune Pages.
systems.details: League Classic hands everyone 2 extra Rune Pages, more than doubles IP per game, doubles Classic XP, and cuts Quintessence cost to 1000 and minor runes to 500, dramatically speeding up rune access.

systems.summary: Champion and Role swapping added to Classic Champion Select, plus the first Council vote.
systems.details: Classic players can now request champion swaps and swap pick order during the Loadout phase, and the in-client Council vote goes live with voting power earned by playing.

systems.summary: About 20 Classic balance changes hitting the strongest and weakest picks.
systems.details: Ahri, Blitzcrank, Evelynn, Ezreal, Gragas, Tristana, Tryndamere, and Twitch all take nerfs (Tryndamere's max crit chance drops 50% ⇒ 30%) while Annie, Ashe, Dr. Mundo, Garen, Kayle, Lux, Miss Fortune, and Sivir get buffs and several major bugfixes.

systems.summary: Summoner's Rift art and lighting pulled closer to the original.
systems.details: Classic's Rift gets restored foliage and decals, updated map details, and reworked spawn and torch lighting for a more authentic old-Rift look.
